Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. SageWell is moving toward a pilot for behavioral health triage and we need to validate Redwood's PHI handling before we proceed. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday (PST) if possible?

- High-level PHI dataflow diagram (ingest -> storage -> inference -> logs)

We need to present to our InfoSec + Legal on Wednesday. If attachments are large, a shared Drive link is fine.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if that speeds things up.

Short answers up front:
- Deployments: Hosted API (data is processed in our hosted environment), Dedicated pools (reserved, tenant-isolated GPU pools), and Private (VPC / on-prem) options are supported. For pilot, many customers choose Dedicated to avoid cross-tenant concerns.
- Encryption: TLS1.2+ in transit; AES-256-GCM at rest. KMS integrations: AWS KMS & customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private.

I've looped in Markus (legal) and Monica (onboarding/solutions) to produce the artifacts and to propose an initial BAA timeline. Can we target a call Wednesday 10:00am PT with your InfoSec + Legal? If so I'll send a calendar invite.

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: SageWell: PHI handling, encryption details & BAA timeline

Sean / Monica — I reviewed Redwood's standard BAA and prepared a redline with the following highlights (attached: Redwood_Draft_BAA_redline.docx):

- Data scope: Our standard BAA already limits scope to processing for specified services; recommend keeping as-is for pilot.
- Subprocessors: We list major infra providers; SageWell may request an explicit commit on notification cadence for added subprocessors. Propose: 30 days notice + right to object for high-risk additions.
- Liability: our standard liability cap applies to aggregate fees paid in prior 12 months. If SageWell asks for a per-incident carveout for willful misconduct, flag to leadership for exception.
- Audit rights: we can offer SOC2 report + attestations; full audits require standard mutual NDA and are scoped.
- Data deletion/return: we confirm option to purge customer PHI on termination and provide verifiable deletion logs for Dedicated/Private (hosted = 90-day retention for logs unless otherwise configured).
- KMS & keys: Dedicated/Private support customer-managed keys (CMK) via AWS KMS / HSM. Hosted supports provider-managed keys by default; customer-managed is possible for enterprise contracts.

Action items:
1) Monica: attach the PHI dataflow and short evidence bundle (SOC2 summary + pentest snapshot).
2) Sean: send consolidated package to Jill, propose Wed 10am PT call, include redline and ask for their items by EOD Tue so legal can prep.

I do not see urgent legal blockers for a pilot. If SageWell requests significant liability changes we need to escalate.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jill Ortiz <jill.ortiz@sagewell.health>, procurement@sagewell.health
Cc: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SageWell: PHI handling, encryption details & BAA timeline

Hi Jill — attaching the package for your InfoSec and Legal team. Thanks for the clarity on timelines; below is a short summary and proposed next steps.

Attachments / links (shared Drive):
- Redwood_PHIdataflow_diagram.pdf — annotated dataflow showing ingestion, transient KV cache, model runtime, and log export points.
- Redwood_Security_Evidence.zip — SOC2 summary (Type II), pentest snapshot (redacted findings), encryption certification excerpts.
- Redwood_Draft_BAA_redline.docx — redline of our standard BAA with callouts from our counsel.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Dataflow: PHI flows into our ingestion endpoints, is kept in memory during inference, and may be cached as KV entries for ongoing sessions. For Hosted, logs and traces are retained for up to 90 days by default (configurable). Dedicated and Private deployments can be configured for stricter retention and isolation. See diagram.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256-GCM at rest. Dedicated & Private support CMKs (AWS KMS) or HSM-backed keys.
- Where PHI can be stored: Hosted (default) / Dedicated (tenant-isolated GPU pools) / Private (VPC or on-prem). For pilot we recommend Dedicated for data isolation without the ops overhead of Private.
- BAA timeline: Markus has provided a redline. If SageWell returns comments by EOD Tue, our counsel can finalize within 3 business days. Execution via DocuSign should be possible within 5 business days after agreement on terms.
- Evidence: SOC2 summary and pentest snapshot included. For deeper audit requests, we can discuss scoped audit or provide additional attestations under NDA.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can we lock Wed, May 6 at 10:00am PT for a 30-minute call with your InfoSec + Legal?
2) Please confirm any non-standard BAA asks by Tue EOD so Markus can prep.
3) If you prefer Dedicated for the pilot, let me know and Monica will prepare a deployment and onboarding checklist.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to walk through the diagram.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
